title: How Many Turns Does the Ring Make? | AMC 8-Style Level 5
description:
A little ring rolls all the way around the inside of a big hoop. Lots of people guess it turns five times, but it doesn't! Vantee shows two ways to count the turns: follow the center, and the five-minus-one trick. Then you get to try a coin rolling around the outside of a plate.
